messages.author: dae01c57a3c54a3a
messages.subject: Can't compile anything with 2.10
parts: I just updated to the latest rstan and now I'm getting an error whenever I try to compile any previously working models. The full session/error is here (https://gist.github.com/mike-lawrence/afddb581b28950f3364578cdbe5e87a2), but it looks like something to do with boost. When I did the rstan install, it said it was also installing the latest rstan-headers, but is there something else I need to do to update?

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Can't compile anything with 2.10
